english.meaning: privately owned or run, not public
english.note: Used before a noun, as in 私家牙醫 (private dentist).

exampleSentences.english: I get my teeth cleaned at a private dentist near home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉呢我係喺屋企附近嗰啲私家牙醫度洗𡃉。
